Functional graph indegree peeling finds every cycle, then reverse topological propagation assigns eventual least period to every state. Independently implemented iterative functional graph classification recovered exact joint tables and transit maxima (GP51: 8409,2460,38430,2190,7560 on diagonal; GP52: diagonal counts 7839,4500,5040,27270,9600 plus (8,4) 4800). Five-subset Kneser realization makes Aut Petersen S5: stars are the only four-point intersecting families, hence group size120. Independent action enumerated all 120 permutations, and the 4800 exceptional configurations form exactly 40 orbits of 120, with no stabilizers. This is a complete finite exhaustive proof, not a sample and not an infinite-family generalization.
